title: RevocationAttestationSignal
description: Category C — operational projection of revocation vote-collection state from the imagodei DNA. Source-of-truth is the DHT-notarized KeyRevocation and RevocationVote entries referenced by actionHash and revocationId. Stream message is reconstructable from the DNA. Unifies two Recovery M4 signals: RecoveryV2Signal::KeyRevocationRequested (attestationKind = 'request') and RecoveryV2Signal::RevocationVoteSubmitted (attestationKind = 'vote'). The controller (Task A.4) uses this to maintain the in-progress revocation vote state in the key_revocations projection table.

actionHash.description: Holochain ActionHash (base64) of the DHT entry that originated this signal. For 'request' kind: the KeyRevocation entry action hash. For 'vote' kind: the RevocationVote entry action hash.

revocationId.description: Stable identifier linking this attestation to the overall KeyRevocation request. Corresponds to Recovery M4 KeyRevocationRequested.id / RevocationVoteSubmitted.revocation_id.

stewardId.description: Agent CID or pubkey of the steward submitting the attestation. For 'request' kind: the initiating steward (initiated_by from M4). For 'vote' kind: the voting steward (steward_id from M4).

approved.description: Whether this attestation approves the revocation. For 'request' kind this is always true (the request itself is an affirmative act). For 'vote' kind this reflects the steward's vote direction.

attestationKind.description: 'request' = initial revocation trigger (maps from M4 KeyRevocationRequested); 'vote' = subsequent steward vote (maps from M4 RevocationVoteSubmitted). The controller can use this to distinguish the initiating event from follow-on votes.

currentVotes.description: Current count of affirmative votes at the time this attestation was recorded.

requiredVotes.description: Vote threshold required for the revocation to become effective.

thresholdReached.description: Whether the vote threshold has been reached as of this attestation. When true, a KeyRevocationSignal should follow shortly after the conductor processes the threshold transition.

attestedAt.description: UTC timestamp at which the attestation was recorded in the DNA. For 'request' kind: created_at from M4 KeyRevocationRequested. For 'vote' kind: voted_at from M4 RevocationVoteSubmitted.

emittedAt.description: UTC timestamp at which the signal was emitted from the conductor post-commit hook.
